description: This file defines the QueryAggregate class, which extends the Query class to implement SQL aggregation queries within Drupal's entity query system. It includes methods for executing, preparing, and building aggregate SQL queries, including group by, sorting, and alias creation.

classes.name: QueryAggregate
classes.description: A class for building and executing SQL aggregate queries in Drupal's entity query system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the query by applying various modifications and returning the result.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the query, clearing ID fields.

methods.name: conditionAggregateGroupFactory
methods.description: Creates a new ConditionAggregate object for query conditions.

methods.name: existsAggregate
methods.description: Checks if an aggregate condition exists.

methods.name: notExistsAggregate
methods.description: Checks if an aggregate condition does not exist.

methods.name: addAggregate
methods.description: Adds aggregate functions to the SQL expressions.

methods.name: compileAggregate
methods.description: Builds the aggregation conditions part of the query.

methods.name: addGroupBy
methods.description: Adds group by clauses to the query.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the query by adding SQL expressions.

methods.name: createSqlAlias
methods.description: Creates a SQL alias for a field, replacing dots with underscores and stripping '_value' suffix if applicable.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Returns the query result, either as an array of rows or a count.
